info.title: Gouda Studios Agent Tools (via Apify)
info.description: Pay per event, with no platform usage fee added. AI agents can pay per run through Apify agentic payments (x402, Skyfire) with no Apify account, or call the tools with an Apify API token, or through the Apify MCP server at https://mcp.apify.com. One-URL MCP endpoint for all tools: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP, Apify OAuth or Bearer Apify token).

post.summary: Run SAM.gov Contract Opportunities and return dataset items
post.description: Get new federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov as clean JSON, no API key needed. Filter by keyword, NAICS, set-aside, notice type, agency and state. Includes deadlines, days left and contracting officer contacts. Monitor mode returns only new notices. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.002 per opportunity.

keywords.description: Optional free-text search over SAM.gov notice titles and text, e.g. "cybersecurity" or "janitorial services". Leave empty to return all notices that match the other filters.

naicsCodes.description: Optional list of 6-digit NAICS industry codes (strings), e.g. ["541511","541512"]. A notice matches if it has any of them. Empty = all industries.

noticeTypes.description: Optional list of notice type codes: o=Solicitation, k=Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, p=Presolicitation, r=Sources Sought, s=Special Notice, a=Award Notice, u=Justification, i=Intent to Bundle, g=Surplus sale. Empty = all types.

setAsides.description: Optional small-business set-aside codes, e.g. ["SBA","8A","SDVOSBC","WOSB","HZC"]. Empty = any set-aside or none.

states.description: Optional 2-letter US state codes for the place of performance, e.g. ["VA","MD"]. Requires includeDetails=true. Empty = all locations.

agencyContains.description: Optional case-insensitive text the agency path must contain, e.g. "Navy" or "Veterans Affairs".

postedWithinDays.description: Only notices posted or updated in the last N days. 0 = no date limit. Use 1-7 for daily/weekly monitoring.

minDaysUntilResponse.description: Optional. Skip notices whose response deadline is fewer than N days away, so you only get ones you can still bid on.

includeDetails.description: true (default) = fetch each notice for NAICS, PSC, set-aside, place of performance, full description and contacts. false = faster, fewer fields.

includeContacts.description: true (default) = include the contracting officer work name, email and phone published on the notice.

onlyNew.description: true = return only notices not delivered in an earlier run with the same filters (state is kept between runs). Use with a schedule for an alert feed.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). You are charged per row returned, so this caps the cost: 100 rows = $0.20 at $0.002/row.

apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free api.sam.gov public API key; when set, the Actor reads the official SAM.gov Opportunities API instead of the public search feed.

post.summary: Run SEC EDGAR Filings and return dataset items
post.description: Monitor SEC EDGAR filings by ticker or CIK, including 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, Form 4 insider trades, Form D and S-1. Each result has the company, form type, filing date and document links. Only-new mode turns it into an alert feed for investors, research and AI agents. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.002 per filing.

tickers.description: Optional stock tickers, e.g. ["AAPL","NVDA"]. Resolved to CIKs with the SEC ticker file.

ciks.description: Optional SEC Central Index Keys, e.g. ["320193"]. Leave tickers and CIKs empty to get latest filings across all companies.

formTypes.description: Form types to include, e.g. ["8-K","10-K","10-Q","4","D","S-1","13F-HR","SC 13D"]. Empty = all forms (company mode only; market-wide mode needs at least one).

filedWithinDays.description: Only filings from the last N days. 0 = no limit (company mode returns the ~1000 most recent).

onlyNew.description: true = skip filings delivered by an earlier run with the same tickers/CIKs/forms. Use with a schedule for an alert feed.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows (1-5000). You pay per row, so this caps cost: 100 rows = $0.20.

contactEmail.description: Optional. SEC asks automated clients to identify themselves; this email is sent in the User-Agent header to sec.gov only.

post.summary: Run USAspending Federal Awards and return dataset items
post.description: Search USAspending.gov federal awards by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date and amount. Get contracts and grants with amounts, recipients, awarding agency and performance dates as JSON. Track competitors, find who won contracts and build sales prospect lists. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.0015 per award.

keywords.description: Optional words to match in award descriptions, e.g. ["cybersecurity"].

recipientNames.description: Optional company or organization names (or UEIs), e.g. ["Booz Allen Hamilton"]. Find a competitor's federal wins.

awardingAgencies.description: Optional top-tier agency names exactly as USAspending lists them, e.g. ["Department of Defense","Department of Veterans Affairs"].

awardType.description: contracts (default), idvs, grants, loans, direct_payments or other.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days ago. USAspending data starts 2007-10-01.

minAmount.description: Optional lower bound on award amount.

maxAmount.description: Optional upper bound on award amount.

onlyNew.description: true = skip awards delivered by an earlier run with the same filters.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows (1-10000). You pay per row: 100 rows = $0.15.

post.summary: Run GLEIF Company LEI Lookup and return dataset items
post.description: Find any company LEI number by name, or look up an LEI, in the official GLEIF global registry. Get the legal name, status, jurisdiction, registration number, legal and HQ address, and direct and ultimate parent companies. For KYC, KYB, vendor checks and data enrichment. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.003 per company.

companyNames.description: Legal names to look up, e.g. ["Apple Inc.","Siemens AG"]. Exact legal name match first, then fuzzy full-text.

registrationNumbers.description: Optional company-registry numbers as reported to GLEIF (registeredAs), e.g. a UK Companies House number.

country.description: Optional ISO 2-letter country of the legal address, e.g. US, GB, DE. Improves name matching.

activeOnly.description: true (default) = skip lapsed/inactive entities for name and registration searches.

maxMatchesPerName.description: How many candidate entities to return per name or registration number (1-50).

includeParents.description: true (default) = add direct and ultimate parent (LEI, name, country) where reported.

maxResults.description: Maximum rows overall (1-5000). You pay per row: 100 rows = $0.30.

post.summary: Run Website Contact Extractor and return dataset items
post.description: Extract emails, phone numbers, social media links and addresses from any list of websites. One clean deduplicated row per site, Cloudflare-protected emails decoded, phones validated, MX checked. Pay only for sites where an email or phone is found. Pricing: $0.0005 per run + $0.0025 per website with contacts.

startUrls.description: Websites or domains to extract contacts from, one per line. Examples: https://www.example.com or example.com. Each site becomes exactly one output row.

maxPagesPerSite.description: How many pages to read on each site, starting with the homepage and then the most likely contact pages (Contact, About, Team, Impressum, Support). You pay per site, not per page, so higher values only cost more time.

defaultCountry.description: Two-letter country code used to read local phone numbers that have no +country prefix, e.g. US, GB, DE, AU.

checkMx.description: Adds a free DNS check that each email domain can receive mail. Flags typos and dead domains.

respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages that a site's robots.txt asks crawlers not to visit.

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most business sites work without a proxy. Turn on Apify Proxy if many sites time out or block requests.

post.summary: Run YouTube Transcript Extractor and return dataset items
post.description: Get the transcript of any YouTube video or Short as clean text, timestamped text, segments and SRT. Bulk URLs, any language, auto-translate. Pay only for transcripts you get; failed videos are free. Pricing: $0.0005 per run + $0.0025 per transcript.

videos.description: Watch URLs, youtu.be links, Shorts, live or embed URLs, or bare 11-character video IDs.

languages.description: Language codes in priority order, e.g. en, es, de. If none match, the first available transcript is returned.

translateTo.description: Language code to auto-translate the transcript into using YouTube's translation, e.g. en.

preferManual.description: Use manually created captions over auto-generated ones when both exist.

includeSegments.description: Add an array of segments with start time and duration.

includeSrt.description: Add an SRT subtitle file as a string.

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave off to use our built-in residential proxy, included in the price. Set your own only if you want to.

availableLanguages.description: All caption tracks on the video

post.summary: Run Google Trends Scraper and return dataset items
post.description: Google Trends Scraper & API: interest over time, interest by region, top and rising related queries and topics, keyword comparison (up to 5) and trending searches, for any country, time range, category or YouTube/News/Shopping search. Fast, reliable, $4 per 1,000 keywords; failed terms are free. Pricing: $0.0005 per run + $0.004 per search term.

searchTerms.description: Keywords or phrases, one per line. You can also paste Google Trends explore URLs; their q, geo, date, cat and gprop override the settings below. Each term returns one result row.

geo.description: ISO code like US, GB, DE, or US-CA. Leave empty for worldwide.

customTimeRange.description: Overrides Time range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2025-01-01 2025-12-31.

category.description: Google Trends category number, 0 for all categories.

property.description: Which Google search the trend data comes from.

relatedTopics.description: Top and rising related topics (best effort: Google often withholds these from automated sessions, so the field may be empty).

compareMode.description: Puts terms in groups of up to 5 on one shared 0-100 scale, like comparing them on trends.google.com. Returns one row per group with interest over time and by region for each keyword. Charged per keyword.

trendingNow.description: Adds one row per currently trending search in the chosen country, with traffic and news links.

language.description: Interface language for names, e.g. en-US, de, es.

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave off to use the built-in residential proxy, included in the price.

maxConcurrency.description: How many search terms are fetched at the same time, each on its own IP.

post.summary: Run Merch Marketplace Counts and return dataset items
post.description: For each merch keyword, return result counts and the top 20 listing titles and URLs from Redbubble, plus TeePublic, Etsy and Amazon Merch shirt counts when those sites allow datacenter access. Blocked marketplaces are flagged, never guessed. $0.002 per keyword. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.002 per keyword.

keywords.description: Phrases or merch keywords, one per line, e.g. christmas cat shirt.

maxListings.description: How many top listing titles and URLs to return for each marketplace that is reachable.

marketplaces.description: Which stores to query. Amazon is a Merch-by-Amazon shirt count when the filter is accepted; otherwise the general search count is returned and flagged.

post.summary: Run Adobe Stock Keyword Gap Scanner and return dataset items
post.description: Scan Adobe Stock keyword saturation (total, photo, video, generative-AI share) and expand seeds into Adobe related searches plus Google autocomplete. No login. About $0.002 per keyword. 30/90-day new-upload counts are not publicly available. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.002 per keyword.

mode.description: scan = result counts per keyword (gap scanner). expand = Adobe related searches + Google autocomplete from each seed. both = run scan then expand on the same keyword list.

keywords.description: Keywords to scan and/or seeds to expand, e.g. walking pad, home office, autumn leaves.

usePublicReaderFallback.description: If stock.adobe.com returns a Datadome/captcha block (common on some datacenter IPs), retry the same public search URL through the free r.jina.ai reader. No paid proxy is used. Turn off to fail instead.

requestDelayMs.description: Polite pause between Adobe Stock page fetches. For ~200 keywords, 400 ms keeps a weekly run short and cheap.

post.summary: Run App Store and Google Play Reviews and return dataset items
post.description: Scrape app reviews from the Apple App Store and Google Play in one run. Give an app name, URL, ID or package and get ratings, review text, dates, versions and developer replies from both stores in one clean JSON schema. No login, no proxy. Pricing: $0 per run + $0.0001 per review.

apps.description: One app per line: an app name (e.g. Spotify), an App Store URL or numeric ID, or a Google Play URL or package name (e.g. com.spotify.music). The matching app in the other store is found automatically.

maxReviewsPerStore.description: Apple's public review feed returns up to 500 reviews per country. Google Play supports up to 5,000.

country.description: Two-letter store country code, e.g. us, gb, de, in.

language.description: Two-letter language code for Google Play reviews.

includeSummary.description: Adds one uncharged row with the store rating, rating count and the rating distribution of the returned reviews.

post.summary: Run ATS Jobs Scraper and return dataset items
post.description: Get every open job from company career sites on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Workday in one clean JSON schema. Give a company name, careers URL or website and the ATS is detected for you. Salaries, remote type, departments, full descriptions. $1 per 1,000 jobs, no proxy. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.001 per job.

companies.description: One per line: a company board name (stripe, openai), a careers page URL (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir, https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite) or a company website (figma.com). The ATS is detected automatically.

keywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title or description contains any of these words. Leave empty for all jobs.

titleKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains any of these words, e.g. engineer, sales.

locations.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains any of these, e.g. New York, Remote, Germany.

postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs posted in the last N days. Great for daily new-job monitoring. Jobs without a date are kept.

withSalaryOnly.description: Keep only jobs where a salary range was published or found in the description.

atsPlatforms.description: Optional. Only look on these platforms.

includeDescription.description: Adds plain-text and HTML descriptions. Turn off for faster, smaller runs.

maxJobsPerCompany.description: Cap on jobs returned per company.

maxJobsTotal.description: Stop after this many jobs across all companies. 0 means no limit.

includeSummary.description: One uncharged row per company with the detected ATS, board name and job count.

post.summary: Run Chrome Web Store Reviews and return dataset items
post.description: Scrape Chrome Web Store reviews past the 500-review cap. Give extension IDs and optional star filters; get rating, date, text, language, version and helpful votes, plus user count, average rating and current version. Free low-star phrase counts. No login or proxy. $0.0001/review. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.0001 per review.

extensionIds.description: One extension per line: a 32-character ID (e.g. cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm) or a chromewebstore.google.com / chrome.google.com/webstore URL.

maxReviewsPerExtension.description: How many reviews to return per extension. 0 means all public reviews (paginated past 500). Default 200.

starFilter.description: Optional list of star ratings to keep, e.g. [1, 2] for one- and two-star reviews only. Leave empty for all ratings.

phrases.description: Optional phrases. Adds one free keywordSummary row per extension with case-insensitive counts over reviews at or below Low-star max. Counts cover only the reviews returned in this run, not estimates.

lowStarMax.description: Phrase counts use reviews with this rating or lower. Ignored if Phrases is empty.

includeSummary.description: Adds one uncharged row with the Store user count, average rating, rating count, current version, and the rating distribution of the reviews returned.

post.summary: Run Instagram Reels, TikTok and Podcast Transcripts and return dataset items
post.description: Transcripts with timestamps for Instagram Reels, TikTok, podcast RSS feeds and any audio/video file URL (mp3, m4a, mp4, wav). Native TikTok captions first, built-in Whisper speech-to-text for the rest. Optional speaker labels (who said what). No login, no API key. Pricing: $0.0005 per run + $0.002 per caption transcript.

videoUrls.description: Instagram Reel/post links, TikTok video links (including vm.tiktok.com short links), direct audio/video file URLs (mp3, m4a, mp4, wav, webm, ogg), and podcast RSS feed URLs (the latest episodes are transcribed). An Instagram profile link is treated as a username.

instagramUsernames.description: Transcribe the most recent video posts and reels of public Instagram accounts. Best effort: Instagram returns up to about 12 recent posts without login.

maxReelsPerProfile.description: How many recent videos to take from each username. Without login Instagram only exposes the latest ~6 posts of a profile (photos are skipped), so you may get fewer.

maxEpisodesPerFeed.description: For podcast RSS feed URLs, how many of the newest episodes to transcribe.

speechToText.description: Instagram has no public captions, so Instagram transcripts always use speech-to-text unless this is Off.

sttModel.description: Open-source Whisper models running inside the actor. Same price for both.

maxTranscribeSeconds.description: Longer videos and episodes are transcribed up to this length and marked truncated: true. Up to 1800 seconds (30 minutes).

language.description: ISO code like en, es, de. Leave empty to auto-detect. Also picks the matching TikTok caption track when several exist.

includeSegments.description: Adds segments: [{start, end, text}] in seconds.

includeSrt.description: Adds the transcript as an SRT subtitle string.

speakerLabels.description: Detects the different voices and labels every segment Speaker 1, Speaker 2, ... Adds speakerTranscript (one line per speaker turn), speakerCount and talk time per speaker. No extra charge for the labels. They need the audio, so TikToks are then transcribed by AI speech-to-text (AI transcript price) instead of captions. Best for podcasts, interviews and multi-person videos.

numSpeakers.description: Only used with speaker labels. Set it when you know how many people talk (for example 2 for an interview) for more accurate labels. 0 = detect automatically.

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. By default the actor connects directly and falls back to a built-in residential proxy when a platform blocks it.

post.summary: Run Shopify App Store Reviews and return dataset items
post.description: Scrape Shopify App Store reviews by handle, with the ratings[] filter, store name, country, time using the app and developer replies. Also returns listing rating, review count, pricing plans and launch date, plus a category listing mode. No login or proxy. $0.00002/review. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.00002 per review.

appHandles.description: One app per line: a handle (klaviyo-email-marketing) or an apps.shopify.com URL. Leave empty if you only want the category listing mode.

maxReviewsPerApp.description: How many reviews to return per app. 0 means all public reviews (paginated). Default 200.

starFilter.description: Optional list of star ratings, passed to the Store as ratings[] (e.g. [1, 2] for one- and two-star reviews). Leave empty for all ratings.

categoryUrl.description: Optional. A Shopify App Store category URL or slug (e.g. marketing-and-conversion-social-trust-product-reviews or the full /categories/.../all URL). Returns one listing row per app with name, rating and review count. Parent categories crawl subcategory /all pages.

maxAppsInCategory.description: Maximum app listing rows to return when Category URL is set.

phrases.description: Optional phrases. Adds one free keywordSummary row per app with case-insensitive counts over reviews at or below Low-star max. Counts cover only the reviews returned in this run, not estimates.

lowStarMax.description: Phrase counts use reviews with this rating or lower. Ignored if Phrases is empty.

includeSummary.description: Adds one uncharged row with the listing rating, review count, launch date, pricing plans, and the rating distribution of the reviews returned.

post.summary: Run Spotify Play Count Scraper and return dataset items
post.description: Get exact Spotify play counts for any track, album, artist or playlist. Returns stream counts per track, album totals, artist monthly listeners, followers, world rank, top cities and top tracks. No login, no proxy, $0.001 per track. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.001 per track play count.

startUrls.description: Track, album, artist or playlist links (open.spotify.com/...) or URIs (spotify:track:...). Mix types freely.

maxTracksPerInput.description: Caps how many track rows each album or playlist returns.

includeAlbumSummary.description: For album inputs, also output one album row with total play count across all tracks (not charged).

post.summary: Run Telegram Channel Scraper and return dataset items
post.description: Scrape public Telegram channels without login or API keys. Get posts with text, date, views, reactions, links, photos, videos and forwards, plus subscriber counts. Date filter, keyword search, full history paging. $0.0003 per post. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.0003 per post.

channels.description: Public channel usernames, @handles or t.me links, e.g. durov, @telegram, https://t.me/s/durov

maxPostsPerChannel.description: Newest posts first. Use 0 to fetch only channel info.

postsNewerThan.description: Optional ISO date or datetime (UTC), e.g. 2026-11-01. Stops paging when older posts are reached.

searchQuery.description: Optional. Returns only posts matching this keyword (Telegram's own in-channel search).

includeChannelInfo.description: Adds one row per channel with title, description, verified flag, subscribers and media counts.

post.summary: Run USPTO Trademark Phrase Screener and return dataset items
post.description: Screen a list of phrases against the public USPTO trademark search (no login, no API key). Returns exact and close wordmarks with serial number, live/dead status, international classes, and flags for any live mark in class 25 or 16. $0.001 per phrase. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.001 per phrase.

phrases.description: Phrases or design names to screen, one per line, e.g. plant mom, just one more chapter.

maxMarksPerPhrase.description: How many exact and close wordmarks to list. Counts and the live class 25/16 flags still use the full hit set.

includeDead.description: If false, listed marks are live only. Dead counts are still reported.

post.summary: Run YouTube Video, Channel, Search and Comments Scraper and return dataset items
post.description: YouTube data in one actor: video details, channel videos, shorts, keyword search, channel search by keyword, playlists and comments. Views, likes, publish date, tags, subscribers, channel video counts. $0.30/1K videos, $2/1K channels. No API key, no proxy. Pricing: $0.00005 per run + $0.0003 per video.

videoUrls.description: YouTube video links (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live) or 11-character video ids. Returns full details for each.

channels.description: Channel @handles, channel URLs or UC... channel ids. Lists the latest videos from each channel.

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Top results per query, in YouTube order.

uploadedWithin.description: Only videos uploaded within this window.

playlistUrls.description: Public playlist links or playlist ids.

fullDetails.description: For channel, search and playlist results, also fetch likes, comment count, exact publish date, tags, category, description and chapters. Turn off for faster, lighter rows. Same price either way.

maxTotalResults.description: Hard cap on charged rows for the whole run.

channelSearchQueries.description: Keywords to find matching YouTube channels (like YouTube search filtered to Channels). Each result is one channel row with channel id, name, @handle, URL, subscriber count, video count, description, avatar, verified flag and external links.

maxChannelsPerQuery.description: Channels returned per keyword, in YouTube order.

channelSearchDetails.description: Also open each found channel to add its video count, full description and keywords. Same price either way.

channelSearchAbout.description: Also read each found channel's About panel to add external links (website, Instagram, X and others), country, joined date and total channel views. Same price either way. Needs Channel details on.

commentVideoUrls.description: YouTube video or Shorts URLs (or 11-character ids). Returns top comments with text, author, likes, reply count, hearted flag and comment link.

maxCommentsPerVideo.description: Comments are returned in YouTube top-comments order.

maxRepliesPerComment.description: 0 skips replies. Replies are returned as rows with type reply and parentCommentId.
